nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer(address,uint) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; whitelist gate (owner, UNI, pairFor-derived pair, tradeAddress, canSale) else requires condition().
transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable; performs allowance/ensure/balance checks then mutates balances and _onSaleNum without SafeMath.
approve(address,uint) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits against _onSaleNum[_from].
delegate(address,bytes) payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address.
_mints(address,uint); privileged mint that overwrites balanceOf and sets canSale[spender]=true.
init(uint,uint,uint); owner-only setter for _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum sale configuration.
batchSend(address[],uint) payable; owner-only loop distributing balances with unchecked multiplication.
setTradeAddress(address); owner-only setter of tradeAddress whitelist slot.
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; computes Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 hash.
UniswapExchange constructor; sets name/symbol/totalSupply, owner=msg.sender, grants infinite UNI allowance.
address private owner; central privilege anchor for all admin functions.
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; per-address sale whitelist bypassing condition().
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-sender sale counter.
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount.
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount.
uint256 private _saleNum; allowed sales per address.
address tradeAddress; whitelisted address bypassing ensure().
uint public totalSupply.
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; whitelisted router address.
msg.sender; attacker-controllable caller used for auth, allowance and from-address derivation.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(); arbitrary delegatecall executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value; unchecked subtraction in transferFrom (no SafeMath).
balanceOf[_to] += _value; unchecked addition in transferFrom.
total = _value * _tos.length; unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)); unchecked exponent/multiplication overwriting balance in _mints.
_to parameter of transfer().
_from parameter of transferFrom()/ensure()/condition().
_value parameter of transferFrom().
_spender parameter of approve().
a and b parameters of delegate() (target and calldata).
local uint total in batchSend().
local address _to inside batchSend() loop.
local address _UNI computed by pairFor in ensure().
loop counter i in batchSend().
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; unchecked subtraction of spender allowance.
_tos array parameter of batchSend().
_value parameter of batchSend().

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer(); collapse into the transfer function node.
_from is consumed by transferFrom/ensure/condition balance and whitelist logic.
_value is the amount argument driving transferFrom state mutations.
_spender is only used to index the allowance slot in approve().
a and b are the target/calldata of the delegatecall performed by delegate().
total is the direct result of the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication.
loop-local _to is only used for balanceOf credits inside batchSend.
_UNI pair address is a temporary used solely by the ensure() whitelist check.
loop counter i only controls iteration of batchSend.
_tos array is only iterated by batchSend.
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation in batchSend.
